description: Na₃BP₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four P atoms to form corner-sharing NaP₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.82-2.89 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent B and four P atoms. There is one shorter (2.83 Å) and one longer (3.08 Å) Na-B bond length. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.19 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one B and four P atoms. The Na-B bond length is 3.00 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.18 Å. B is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two P atoms. Both B-P bond lengths are 1.78 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one B atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one B atom.
